title: Interior and Cause Are Not-Self
html:
• Saṁyutta Nikāya 35.142 Linked Discourses 35.142
  • 14. Devadahavagga 14. At Devadaha

Ajjhattānattahetusutta Interior and Cause Are Not-Self

“Cakkhuṁ, bhikkhave, anattā. “Mendicants, the eye is not-self. Yopi hetu, yopi paccayo cakkhussa uppādāya, sopi anattā. The cause and reason that gives rise to the eye is also not-self. Anattasambhūtaṁ, bhikkhave, cakkhu kuto attā bhavissati …pe… Since the eye is produced by what is not-self, how could it be self?

jivhā anattā. The ear … nose … tongue … body … Yopi hetu yopi paccayo jivhāya uppādāya, sopi anattā. Anattasambhūtā, bhikkhave, jivhā kuto attā bhavissati …pe… mano anattā. mind is not-self. Yopi hetu yopi paccayo manassa uppādāya, sopi anattā. The cause and reason that gives rise to the mind is also not-self. Anattasambhūto, bhikkhave, mano kuto attā bhavissati. Since the mind is produced by what is not-self, how could it be self?

Evaṁ passaṁ …pe… Seeing this … nāparaṁ itthattāyā’ti pajānātī”ti. They understand: ‘… there is nothing further for this place.’”

Navamaṁ.
